THE RECESS CLIP (NEW, and the run's hardest-won lesson): a recess viewed obliquely hides a band of its own floor equal to the recess depth's screen projection, so drawing the floor and walls unclipped makes every groove read as a raised BLOCK sitting on the surface. Clip all recess interiors to the OPENING polygon. Three pixel critics independently reported the inverted read before the cause was found.

entries.hero_structure: THE HOUR COLUMN (NEW): a vertical two-material quantity column standing on a wet boat deck under ONE orthographic GPU camera, built so that one world unit is one hour at a printed, constant 14.0 px per hour. The bottom 7 hours render as BRUSHED STEEL (the natural window a fish has always had) and the 53 hours above as POLISHED BRASS (the manufactured window). The MATERIAL CHANGE AT THE 7 HOUR LINE is the thesis with zero words. Orthographic because the slide draws a QUANTITY and doctrine bars perspective on quantities. The column is the hero on only 2 of 9 slides (a close detail crop on the cover, the full measured object on S03), so it is deliberately NOT deck 17's one-object-under-one-camera register. NOT a rendered gold authority seal (15), NOT the Adjudicated Margin op-ed chassis with a pen (16), NOT the milled bone limestone register (17), NOT the dead-end insulator string on a yoke plate (18).
entries.atmosphere: SODIUM ON SILT: a warm sodium deck lamp (az 118, el 55, key to fill about 5 to 1) over warm brown-black glacial silt (#1A140D / #241B12 / #4A3218), CLEAR AIR with no fog anywhere, and cold confined to exactly one material in the deck, the slush ice. Dark ground (the one light-deck-per-8-runs allowance was spent on 2026-07-25). Deliberately warm-dominant to escape deck 18's cold low-chroma graphite-teal sea fog on wet steel, which was the trap the field-documentarian director was the only one to price. NOT op-ed warm ink-black paper (16), NOT gallery-lit bone (17), NOT sea fog on wet steel (18).

entries.post_score_repair_note: The material change at hour 7 did NOT fully render. Under a single 0xffb067 sodium key, steel at 0xb9bcbd and brass at 0xd39c31 both read as one amber extrusion at feed scale. The repair pass lifted the steel to 0xe8edf0 at roughness 0.62 and added a proud collar at the seam so the change reads as a joint rather than a gradient; darkening the brass to force contrast made the frame muddier and was reverted. The encoding now reads better but not fully. Two materials separated only by hue collapse under a strongly coloured key: separate by value and by a physical joint.
entries.plate_system_note: Every mono knockout and chip in this deck was hand-sized at roughly 14px per character against JetBrains Mono's actual 16.8px at 24px with 0.10em tracking. Six labels shipped past their own plates into the scorer. Future decks must compute plate width as 16.8 x charcount + 2 x padding; render.py and qa.py now gate this automatically.

entries.hero_structure: THE INHABITED DARK (NEW): a single Interior Alaska winter valley at night as a five-plane multiplane field, revisited from nine camera stations, where every light source in the world is human. entries.atmosphere: ICE FOG AT FORTY BELOW. Cold high-chroma blues, snow as the major surface, warm cream only where a person is awake. NOT gallery-lit bone (17), NOT sea fog on wet steel (18), NOT sodium amber on glacial silt (19). Dark ground.
entries.depth_technique: AK3D-style ridged heightfield ranges inside a multiplane stack, four parallax rates against a shared global x so the planes seam exactly without a 9720px canvas, ice fog slab with stipple, banded drift filled light-to-dark along its own contour, AKPOST.grade with IGN dither on every art canvas. entries.hero_structure: THE ENGRAVED INSTRUMENT (NEW). A lit paper sheet on a copy stand under one raking key, carrying WHITE-LINE INTAGLIO, revisited at ten stations. The hero (S05) is the 2006 certificate whose guilloche rosette IS the vote, an epitrochoid with R = 113.130 (the YES count scaled 1000 to 1), r = 41.836 (the NO count), d = 73.00 (the percentage as the tracing arm) and 73 turns, so R/r = 2.7042 and the curve never closes. NOT the milled bone limestone register (17), NOT the GPU PBR dead-end insulator string (18), NOT the orthographic Hour Column (19), NOT the Inhabited Dark winter valley multiplane (20). All three treatment directors independently chose line engraving without seeing each other's pitches, the strongest convergence the room has produced in twenty runs.

NOT sea fog on wet steel (18), NOT sodium amber on glacial silt (19), NOT ice fog at forty below (20), and deliberately NOT the series' default cold arctic navy the scorer marked No.20 down for.
entries.depth_technique: WHITE-LINE INTAGLIO via the new assets/js/akengrave.js. Cut lines print LIGHT against a solid inked field, the dark register's native form of line engraving, which keeps the deck out of the barred light ground (the one-light-deck-per-8-runs allowance was spent 2026-07-25). Four engraver's rules implemented rather than described. The lay wraps the form, direction = rot90 of the height field's gradient, so the direction field IS the modelling. The swelled line, every stroke a filled tapered polygon and never a stroked path. Three separately controllable channels, mainline, crossline, interdot, which is a per-region detail budget expressed as a drawing system. Thickness is a lighting decision made per stroke, so lines fatten in shadow and thin toward the key. HERO SHIPPED FLAT AND ARGUED IT rather than climbing to akthree, because all three directors flagged that hairline engraving resampled onto a mesh by a software GPU averages to flat gray, which is No.19's failure in a new material; the relief substrate shares the hero's height field so the form shading and the lay cannot disagree.
entries.line_voice: THE BURIN (NEW). The drafting bench that carried 17, 18 and 19 stays retired. Weight is set by light per stroke, quantized to the five-token ladder for anything that is not a lay line. Crossline enters only where tone is below 0.45, interdot only below 0.22.

entries.hero_structure: THE UNFILLED SHEET (NEW). One true-projection Alaska (conic equal area, parallels 55/65, rotate 154) rendered as an Imhof-manner relief sheet and revisited from eight camera stations, with all 29 boroughs and census areas drawn as cased hairlines and EVERY ONE LEFT UNFILLED, because no source says where the 3,048 live. One gold point, at Anchorage's true projected coordinate. The map is not a locator inset; it is larger than the frame at every station but the close, it carries all the deck's tone, and the deck's central fact is a property of the map itself.
entries.atmosphere: HIGH-ALTITUDE SHEET LIGHT. NO fog layer anywhere in the deck. Depth comes from Imhof's aerial perspective as a VALUE rule keyed to elevation and from nothing else. entries.depth_technique: Imhof Swiss-manner relief implemented directly against noise.js rather than through akrelief, because akrelief exposes no median generaliser and no post-Lambert contrast hook and both ARE the Swiss manner. Heightfield defined in STATION-A SCREEN SPACE so every station shades the same terrain; 3x3 MEDIAN x2 then 50 pct fade back (a median preserves ridge and canyon definition where a blur smears them); 3x3 Sobel normals at strength 13.0; three-light aspect-weighted Lambert (az 315/270/360 at el 38/30/30); elevation-keyed contrast rule; two-stop ramp clamped 3 to 90 pct. Bathymetric contours via d3.contours in the water. Zero WebGL, so the post-GL grade penalty is retired by construction.

entries.notes: THE RUN'S OWN CRAFT RULE CAUSED THE RUN'S OWN RECURRING DEFECT. The dossier's elevation-keyed contrast rule damped the flats to 45 pct of contrast; in this projection the ranges sit mid-frame and the bottom third is Gulf water and peninsula lowland, so the rule itself produced the dead lower third and failed frame_balance on three slides. Raising the floor to 0.62 fixed the dead band and, per the scorer, traded it for a flat one. The heightfield also ran at 3.4 noise units across a 1080px frame, so the Sobel returned near-flat normals and the state shaded as one pale mass until a detail octave and strength 13.0 went in.

entries.hero_structure: THE POSTING LANES (NEW). A fixed, flat, parallel-projection instrument bed. A 770 px rail runs 20 July to 24 August at a printed, constant 22.0 px per day; notice lanes are cabinet-extruded bars on it, each starting at its posting date and terminating in a raised gate block at its closing date. THE CAMERA NEVER MOVES, on any of the ten slides, which is how this breaks the one-object-N-camera-stations shape shared by No.19, No.21 and No.22 by construction rather than by argument. Craft spends across four subjects (the lane bed, the eight-plate fan, the Eielson ground, the posting board slab) plus the search register. NOT the Hour Column (19), NOT the Inhabited Dark (20), NOT the Engraved Instrument (21), NOT the Unfilled Sheet (22).
entries.atmosphere: LOW-ANGLE TERMINAL GLOW. Clear air. No fog, no veil, no haze, no volumetric shaft and no horizon anywhere in ten slides. One low key behind and below the bed at azimuth 205 elevation 22, so every lane wall is backlit at its top bevel and throws a short forward two-part contact shadow. NOT ice fog at forty below (20), NOT copy-stand rake (21), NOT high-altitude sheet light (22).

entries.line_voice: INSTRUMENT. entries.continuity_device: (A) THE DEADLINE RAIL, present in the lower band of all ten slides at a constant printed 22.0 px per day, changing state by SHAPE never brightness: three standing gold gates (01), one lit lane (02), eight feeders (03), the rail IS the slide (04), ground occlusion with one lit gate (05), ALL GATES DARK (06), two lanes at two elevations (07), a declared axis break with a HOLLOW gold target tick because a target is not a gate (08), folded into a board spine carrying day-pitch ticks (09), gates SHUT and a phantom tail past 24 August carrying NO ticks because the deck can't say what happens after (10). It deliberately does NOT rise into the Polaris at the close, a move that carried No.13, No.14 and No.19 and is now a tic. (B) THE SEARCH REGISTER, three states by SILHOUETTE: open dashed box (searched, not found), solid block inside a box (document not read), solid gold fill (present). One lit cell in the entire deck, on S08. (C) PALETTE ARC, near-black at 01 to the deck's warmest damson at 08, cooling for the close.

entries.palette_family: INK PLUM AND QUARTZ. Ground #0A070C / #150E14 / #221722, damson wash #2E1B2C at the S08 peak, mulberry structure #4A2C42 and #6E4560, lane bevel #8C6B82, quartz #F1ECEF, bone #C8BCC4, slate #5C6470 (ART ONLY, never type), gold #FFC72C meaning a deadline the public can act on and, on S08 only, the term printed. THE DIVERGENCE WAS MADE FALSIFIABLE BEFORE THE BUILD: mean ground hue must sit between 300 and 340 at 432px, against navy's 210 to 250. Every pixel critic and the scorer independently measured plum at roughly 305 to 325. This is the process fix that broke the two-deck streak where No.20 and No.22 both claimed distinctiveness in prose and landed in the house navy.
entries.type_pairing: Bricolage Grotesque (display 700, wdth 85 to 92) + Manrope (body 400) + JetBrains Mono (instrument, 24px floor at 0.10em, 16.8px per character, every plate computed from that and never typed). Audited independently by two directors against the FULL 22-deck ledger. Bricolage has carried a face at No.6, No.12 and No.17; Manrope at No.1, No.4, No.8, No.11, No.16 and No.22; the two have never appeared in the same deck and the trio has never shipped. HONEST CAVEAT recorded rather than overclaimed: type_temperature 4 normally implies a serif display and every warm serif trio available had already shipped, so this deck reaches temperature through Bricolage's calligraphic contrast and the warm ground instead. Call it a measured 3.5 to 4.

entries.shortfall: Artwork craft 6.0, the declared target, unmoved. The akthree GPU beat was never built. The computed TOOTH density falloff ran in code and is not legible in any render, reported independently by multiple critics. The flat outlined rectangle became the deck's real default on S03 and S05. S09 carries the synthesis on the weakest thumb in the deck. The declared clip of S06's lattice at x=700 did not land.
entries.notes: Score 8.37, 0 hard fails, 4+ revision rounds. Third consecutive run settled by blind convergence: all three directors independently chose a records world, a dark warm non-navy register, a small-cell state machine as continuity, and a printed pixels-per-day rail as the keepable. The pixel critics caught a FACTUAL error no machine gate can see, S04 printing FIVE STATE POSTINGS while counting a federal Air Force industry day as a state posting, contradicting S09 inside the same deck. The flow critic caught the structural one, that S05 was firing the search register a slide before the turn and spending the withheld word; cutting it fixed three findings at once.
